firstFoothold.samplingNote: Post-update read-only sampling; reach attempts rejected before a state transition are not directly observable.

firstFootholdEvents.note: Method-call wrappers preserve original return/throw. Gate reasons are derived candidates, not owner-emitted rejection codes.

coverage.note: Runtime method-signature checks, not a SHA/hash or a claim of byte-identical local source.

releaseGate.note: OwnerAwayIntent and peelHoldAge are read directly after actual owner method. Candidate normals and modeled threshold reasons are derived, not owner-issued refusal codes.
